vals: The property must be assigned to a Fee Pool in Yardi before the PM Fee functionality can be used.  The fee pool assigned is what adjusts the Yardi calculation to deduct items the PMA indicates should be excluded from gross collections (example: utility rebills or term fees)
On the Calculation tab, key in data in all relevant yellow cells
Note 1: in the "Application Fee" field in cell C13, key in the amount the property charges to residents as an application fee
Note 2: If a property has a maximum management fee, override the 9,999,999 in cell N11 with the maximum. Otherwise, leave the 9,999,999 as-is so the calculations work correctly.

Client Yardi Databases ONLY - Copy/paste the charge codes related to Admin fees, Application Fees, Late Fees and Prepaids from column D on the January Yardi Report and paste special - values into cells L90-L93 on the Calculation tab (this step will need to be done
after the January Yardi report is pasted in). Also paste the GL description for Prepaid Rent into cell M93.
If the property has retail, complete yellow cells in rows 113-119 on the Calculation tab.  In cell M119, select:
Fee Pool Report - if the retail property code is assigned a fee pool in Yardi
Rec Sum by CC - if the retail property code is not assigned a fee pool in Yardi
If the property has asset management fees, complete the yellow cells in rows 124-128 on the Calculation tab
Verify the prior month's data was transferred to the "Annual" tab (if not first month).  Complete step 16 below before proceeding if data still needs to be transferred.
Select the Current Period in cell C9 on the Calculation tab
In Yardi, Select Management Fee Calculation from the Mgmt Fees menu
All of the fields shown below must be filled out EXACTLY as illustrated.  Please note the following two important things:
> The Fee Date should always be the first day of the month you are calculating.  Ex: 02/01/2024, 03/01/2024, 04/01/2024, etc… DO NOT SELECT AME DATE OR ANY DATE OTHER THAN THE FIRST.
> You must enter the calculation month in BOTH "As of Month" fields.  The calculation will be incorrect if you do not enter the month in both the white and blue cells.
Hit the calculate button.  This will generate the fee calculation on the screen.  (Note: sometimes you have to hit this twice for some reason)

Next, hit the Post button.  This will generate the Accrual JE as an unposted JE.  DO NOT POST THE JE AT THIS TIME as the amount will need to be modified for adjustments calculated outside the system.  The calculation (not the JE) MUST be posted BEFORE the custom detailed report can be run.
Run the custom detailed report using the following path and parameters.
Enter property code and month, select excel, check the merge reports box and then hit generate. Paste excel file into the "Yardi Report" tab.

Click the "Check for New GL Accounts" button on the Calculation tab. This will run a macro that will check for any new GL Accounts appearing on the Yardi report for the first time during the year and will add them to column I and the Annual tab.
Verify the total from the custom detailed report tie to cells I85 on the Calculation tab.

If a property has retail AND is assigned a fee pool in Yardi, repeat steps 3-7 but paste the Yardi report for the retail property code into the Retail tab and verify cell I113 on the calculation tab matches the retail report.
If a property has retail but is not assigned a fee pool in Yardi, run the Receivable Summary by Charge Code report for the retail entity and paste it into the Retail tab.

Run the Receivable Detail by Charge Codes report for the current period for ONLY the late fee charge code.  Make sure you run the Receivable Detail by Charge Code report and NOT the Greystar Receivable Detail by Charge Code report.
Copy ONLY columns A-M from the report and paste into cell A1 on the Late Fees tab.  It is very important you not copy and paste the whole report.
Run the Non-Resident Receipts report for the current period and paste into the "NonResReceipts" tab
Note: Make sure each ALL Inclusive Draft has been posted for the current month before proceeding.  Take care in completing this section on the Annual tab using the following guidelines:
ResLink Enrollments: This is income to the property that is recorded as part of the All Inclusive journal entries.  Manually add the amount by keying in the amount in cell I94 on the Calculation tab.

Bad Debt Recovery recorded via JE: This is income to the property that is recorded as part of the All Inclusive Draft journal entries.  Manually add the amount by keying in the amount in cell I95 on the Calculation tab.
Bad Debt Recovery recorded by the site as a receipt should already be picked up in the custom report (unless fee pool excludes).  You should only need to adjust for recovery recorded by JE.
Insurance Proceeds: Deduct any insurance proceeds recorded as non-resident receipts in the current month.  VERIFY the amount is included in the custom report before manually deducting.

Team Member Housing Reimbursements: This is income to the property that is recorded as part of the All Inclusive journal entries.  Manually add the amount by keying in the amount in cell I97 on the Calculation tab.
*The manual adjustment should equal the net of the amount posted via All Inclusive drafts (net credit in GL should be (+) adjustment; net debit in GL should be (-) adjustment)

Airbnb Resident Hosting Income: This is income to the property that is recorded via a consolidated national monthly JE for properties in Greystar Yardi 7s (beginning 1/1/25). Manually add the amount by keying in income recorded via JE in GL Account 43213-000 in cell I98 on the Calculation tab.
Use cells I100-I102 to record any other miscellaneous adjustments.
DO NOT DO A MANUAL ADJUSTMENT FOR THE ANNUAL VENDOR REBATES that come through the All Inclusive in Sept/Oct. We exclude those from the PM Fee calc entirely.

All miscellaneous amounts that are included in the Yardi report will reflect in the grey box (one sub-total per GL account). The green box will display all items on the non-resident receipt report (as individual items).
> Look for items you see in the green box that you don't see in the grey box, then assess whether they should added as a manual adjustment.
Nothing in the grey box should be listed as a (+) manual adjustment as the income is already included in the base total in line 85.
Before adding a (+) manual adjustment - verify the income is not excluded per the PMA/Fee pool set-up.
If a property has asset management fees: on the Calculation tab, enter the dollar amount of any minimum fees in column M (when applicable) and the fee % in column G.

Hit the "Transfer to Annual Summary" button.  Note: the macro copies and pastes all data in column I on the calculation tab and pastes it into the next blank column on the Annual tab.  If something changes after you run the macro and you need to update the annual tab;

go to the annual tab, highlight the entire column for the current month - click the delete button on your keyboard to clear all data in the column.  You can then hit the "Transfer to Annual Summary" button on the calculation tab to transfer the updated info to the annual tab.
**This only works to update the current month.
Locate and open the JE generated when the Auto-calc was run in Yardi and modify the amount to match the revised amount to draft per the calculation tab.
To prorate the monthly fee, simply type the number of days that we should collect a fee for over "No" in cell G107.
If a property does not have Retail or Asset Management Fees, you can click the minus sign next to either section on both the Calculation tab and the Annual tab to hide.
If you run the detailed report and its populated with all zeros, you likely did not Post the calculation before running the report.  Go back to step 4.

If you try to re-run the calculation, you will get an error message that the calculation has already been run for the selected period and you will have to unpost the calculation first using this menu selection:
If the amount of the fee looks roughly twice as much as it should, you likely left this field blank

Before you can rerun the calculation, the system requires you to first post the incorrect calculation. If you see this error message, hit Post. Then delete the JE that was generated by posting the calculation.
Then you can use the Unpost Management Fee Calculation and then the system will allow you to rerun the calculation
